Running until Friday 24th September, you can [b]get up to 77% off Project Highrise[/b] as well as up to [b]50% off all Project Highrise DLC[/b] including:

[list]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/582540/Project_Highrise_Las_Vegas/]Las Vegas[/url]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/636500/Project_Highrise_Miami_Malls/]Miami Malls[/url]

Matt & Rob

notes.title: Project Highrise turns 4!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

This time 4 years ago, we released our anticipated PC game [i]Project Highrise[/i] to the world!

So we just wanted to take the time to thank each & every one of you for supporting us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25230864/2f0b2b92b36f22e630acb1b1d7cc4bb487b05714.jpg[/img]

Since 2016, we have:

- Welcomed over 250,000 architects
- Received over 2300 recommended reviews
- Released 5 DLCs & expansions (Tokyo Towers, Miami Malls, London Life, Brilliant Berlin & Las Vegas)
- Launched on Nintendo Switch with the feature-complete Architect's Edition
- Added exciting decor & building updates & so much more!

[h3]But we're not stopping there. [/h3]

To celebrate, we're hosting a number of events throughout the day today!

Join us for: 

- An exclusive Architect Awards video featuring JackSepticEye & many more on [url=https://www.twitter.com/KasedoGames]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://www.facebook.com/KasedoGames]Facebook[/url]
- A merch giveaway on [url=https://www.twitter.com/KasedoGames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/KasedoGames]Facebook,[/url] [url=discord.gg/KasedoGames]Discord[/url] & [url=https://www.instagram.com/KasedoGames]Instagram[/url]
- A live AMA on Steam's official [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Steam]subreddit[/url] (4pm BST / 5pm CET / 10am CDT)
- A [url=discord.gg/KasedoGames]Discord [/url] party with us & the whole Somasim team, where we'll stream the game & celebrate (7pm BST / 8pm CET / 6am CDT)

So come join us today for this sky-high celebration across social media & Discord as we reflect, celebrate & welcome in our 5th year!

All the best,

Matt & Rob

Somasim Games

notes.content:

notes.title: Miami Malls Content Pack Released!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to Miami[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/7ca2050a4318bc9d03476ca9e130e9740867dc7d.jpg[/img]

In the Miami Malls content pack you’ll strive to establish a mall that rivals some of the world’s great shopping centers. 

The Miami Malls content pack features:
[list]
[*][b]15 additional stores and restaurants![/b] Now you’ll be able to create shopping centers that no longer need offices, apartments or hotels to draw in visitors.
[*][b]Bus terminals and train stations[/b] that will bring even larger crowds to fill your malls and shopping centers.
[*]An [b]observation deck[/b] to draw in droves of tourists who might just stop by a food court or a souvenir shop while they’re heading up to take in the panoramic city views.
[*][b]Towering mall fountains[/b], decorations and wallpapers with tropical flair to match the new Miami Malls stores and restaurants.
[*]...and even more features to help you build a magnificent Miami Mall!
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/636500/Project_Highrise_Miami_Malls/
Even if you're not ready to head to Miami, we've got some additions and changes that are available to everyone!

[list]
[*]Add your own bit of Miami flavor to your skyscrapers with [b]six new summertime decos[/b] in the "Seasonal" tab of the decos menu.
[*]We've redone the logic for visitor generation for retail stores and for some restaurants. You should see a better balance of visitors in all of those.

Full release notes for version 1.5.5 including the new content pack can be viewed here:
https://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt

notes.title: Update 1.5.4 now available - and an announcement!
notes.content:
1.5.4 is now available! The big addition for 1.5.4 is are the "Fast Track" actions. These can be found in the consultants menu and allow you to spend influence to get one-time boosts. And they can be repeated - if you have enough influence!

We're also announcing a new content pack - [b]Miami Malls[/b] - which will be available on July 13. Check out the store page for more details!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/636500/Project_Highrise_Miami_Malls/

[b]New Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]New "Fast Track" actions in the Consultants dialog. You can spend influence to get one-time boosts, and repeat them as many times as desired (but their price goes up over time). Each fast track action unlocks only after unlocking the entire category of upgrades.
[*]New one-time event for tourist/entertainment events to match the business event
[*]New keyboard shortcuts
[list]
[*]Infrastructure: Z (bulldoze), X (build floor), C (build standard elevator)
[*]TAB (press repeatedly to pan camera to top floor, ground floor, and return)
[*]Shift-Q / Shift-E (zoom all the way in or out)
[*]R (show ADA reports)
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Steam build: visual updates to the main menu, bottom info bar
[*]Updates to French, German, Italian, Russian and Spanish translations
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with hotel, casino and event related one-time events occurring without the appropriate things being built
[/list]


Complete history of release notes:
https://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt

notes.content:
We'll have a few new features in a couple of weeks. In the meantime, this is a quick fix for some bugs that came up during the recent Las Vegas expansion release. 

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed building of donut shops from the food court tenants list
[*]Fixed error with "Fluid Formations" contract in Home Suite Home scenario
[*]Changed unclear language in "Project Prestige" contract in Live/Work scenario
[*]Changed mouseover for unlimited mode to clarify that achievements will be disabled
[*]Fixed visual bug with people sleeping outside of their room in certain small suites

notes.title: Welcome to Las Vegas - Expansion Pack is Released!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to the ostentatious but brilliant Las Vegas.[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/4a26f6c1cb60e7286e3a23cd3ccf92e8297a982a.gif[/img]
You need to push your management skills to the limit as you try and build the city's next big resort. Transform the once desolate desert of Las Vegas into a swanky hotel, vast casinos and millions of tourists dreaming of making it big. 

The cutthroat world of Sin City features:
[list]
[*][b]Casinos[/b] – Entice people to come and part with their hard-earned money in style, with all new casinos.
[*][b]Hotels[/b] – Why do your visitors need to leave at all? Keep the business travellers and high-rollers rolling through, with rooms of all sizes that fit every need - but be sure to keep them happy as your ratings depend on it!
[*][b]Events & Shows[/b] – Bring in the best show in town, and attract crowds of happy visitors... and their wallets. Have them come in for the show, but stay for the food and the games.
[*][b]VIPs[/b] – Invite rock stars, comedians, or business gurus to come and perform at your venue – but just don’t expect them to come for free! The bigger the celebrity, the bigger the demands.  
[*][b]Evolved Gameplay[/b] – Experience how the new location challenges your building skills, from new type of Air Conditioning utility, to special service elevators, NPCs, random events and more.
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/582540/

[*][b]New tenants[/b] – New retail and restaurant tenants are now available.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Building Amenities is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25230864/432f0e882d282002dd6dfaf9d467d390158046d5.jpg[/img]
Here are the details of the 1.1.0 content update.
[list]
[*][b]Vending machines[/b] are small additions that will help make your residents happy. It gives them a place to take a quick break and escape from their desks for a few minutes. If there is a vending machine on the same floor, chances are that at break time, you’ll see some office workers head over to grab a snack.
[*][b]Pay phones[/b] provide a place for office and apartment dwellers to converse privately in public. Look for them to head there when they need a break to phone home or to make a call away from prying eyes. Since privacy requires some soundproofing, these will also cut the spread of noises a bit as well. Like vending machines, residents will only go to pay phones located on the floor where they live or work.
[*][b]Shoe shine stations[/b] help residents keep their fancy footwear in top form. They’ll visit them during break-time or free time if they are located on the same floor as their office or apartment.
[*][b]Common areas[/b] are relaxing oases from the rigors of urban life. Residents will seek them out during off hours for a few calm moments. They also slightly reduce the spread of noises and smells.
[*][b]Custodial supply rooms and broom closets[/b] help reduce wear and tear and cut down grime. As your building grows, you’ll be able to unlock a supply room that will allow you to place up to three broom closets. If a broom closet is built, grime will accumulate much more slowly for tenants on the same floor as the broom closet. Gaining more prestige will grant you access to more supply rooms and allow placement of more broom closets. Since you are only able to build a few of these, make sure that you place them on high-traffic floors or areas that quickly accumulate grime!
[/list]

Full release notes can be accessed here: 
http://highrise-static.storage.googleapis.com/release-notes.txt

- Fixed art gallery consultants incorrectly demanding utilities
- Fixed a bug where construction grid was displayed mis-aligned after a height upgrade
